); } API reference LogoCluster Prop Type Default Description label string "The affectUI mark surrounded by…" Accessible description of the illustration className string – Extra class on the root, e.g. for width Accessibility Exposed as one image with a descriptive label; the bubbles are hidden from screen readers Motion When the cluster comes into view the middle circle appears, then the logos quickly bounce out of it one after another Once they land, the ring turns slowly clockwise while every logo stays upright – paused while off screen Hovering a bubble grows it slightly with a springy ease and a softer shadow With prefers-reduced-motion everything is in place right away Responsive behavior Square, scales with the width of its container (max 420px) – every size is in container units Light and dark mode via a .dark class or data-theme="dark" Notes for AI Give your coding assistant this summary instead of screenshots. Swap the mark in the middle for your own logo: replace the MARK path and its viewBox Company logos belong to their owners – check you may show them before you ship Related Integration Grid Card illustrations Honeycomb-like wall of integration logos around a bright centre tile with your product mark, fading out toward the edges Model Wheel Card illustrations AI model names on a turning drum – the rows bend away at the edges and each model lands on a soft gray fill affectUI · 54 components · 12 screens · 11 blocks · 24 illustrations · 8 motion effects affectUI Agent-ready React UI for AI products – one file each, no dependencies.
